tab_worldbox_suite_desc: Unified tools for giant multi-continent maps, live conflict radar, diplomacy, ruins, co-op god mode, and suite modules.
suite_open_hub_description: Open the WorldBox Suite master panel to toggle every installed module from one place.
suite_war_matrix_description: Track active wars, casualties, live skirmishes, and kingdom opinion scores with 1-click camera jumps.
suite_battle_radar_description: Draw pulsing clash rings over active fights on the map so you never miss a major battle.
suite_world_builder_description: Generate a brand-new pre-stitched multi-continent world with custom biomes, ocean divides, and stepping-stone islands.
suite_core_scale_description: Giant map sizes up to 24x24 chunks, adaptive simulation LOD, shadow culling, and mega-army battalion compression.
suite_visual_polish_description: Switch atmospheric lighting presets, toggle dynamic day/night cycles, adjust vignette, and use photo mode.
suite_grand_warfare_description: Ship-to-ship naval broadsides, coastal bombardment, port blockades, supply-line attrition, and defense pacts.
suite_linked_continents_description: Send fleets and expedition armies across ocean map edges between separate WorldBox continent saves.
suite_era_chronicle_description: Track 5-tier kingdom eras with veteran milestones and record JSON history timelines for WorldBox Studio.
suite_apex_factions_description: Warden Sleeping Giant doctrine with 3-strikes mercy ceasefires, instant species awakener, and feral pack domains.
suite_world_relics_description: Gated city perimeter walls, stone sea-strait bridges, and centuries-long mossy ruin decay for fallen empires.
suite_coop_host_description: Host a live browser Co-Op God Console over LAN, Tailscale, or playit.gg so a second player shares your world.
suite_modern_age_description: Tier 1-3 firearms, tanks, helicopters, jets, capital radar SAM domes, 6 governments, and international trade.
